ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central 80% of the fluke area; bounded by a continuous black trailing edge border; distinct dark linear clusters radiate from the proximal junction into the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe displays consistent fine-scale serration (2-4 pixel amplitude); left lobe exhibits irregular, larger-scale indentations (10-15 pixel depth) concentrated on the medial half of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes leading to sharp, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small, dark-pixel circular clusters (3-6 pixels in diameter) observed primarily in the medial-distal white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple low-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) oriented obliquely across the proximal white fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; prominent dark linear scarring pattern originating at the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical, dark-pigmented 'rake-like' marks at the base of the fluke forming a distinct visual anchor at the peduncle junction.
